name: Hue
provinceNote: Hue is a centrally governed city.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Sleep on the south bank of the Perfume River and cross to the Imperial City in the morning. An adult ticket is 200,000 VND and does not include the tombs. At dusk, walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh. Go to Hoi An when the old town is the reason you came.
timeNeeded: A citadel morning and a river evening. Tomb rides are check on arrival.
fee: Imperial City 200,000 VND. Tombs are separate.
getThere: Phu Bai is 13 km southeast, or about 15 km. SE trains from Hanoi take 12 hours 35 minutes to 14 hours 12 minutes.
seoTitle: Hue travel guide — the citadel morning and river dusk
seoDescription: The Imperial City opens at 06:30 or 07:00. An adult ticket is 200,000 VND. The tombs are separate. Sleep on the south bank and walk the river at dusk.
intro: Sleep on the south bank. The culture department calls that bank the modern city and the north bank the old imperial city, joined by Phu Xuan Bridge. Kỳ Đài, the flag tower built in 1807, stands on the north bank. Nghinh Lương Đình, the old royal landing, is the far end of the river path.

Give the morning to the Imperial City. The conservation centre’s notice of 12 March 2024 opens the visiting points at 06:30 from 16 March to 15 October, and at 07:00 from 16 October to 15 March. A direct reload of that page timed out on 21 October 2026, so confirm the board. An adult ticket is 200,000 VND. Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh are not on it. Gia Long, Dong Khanh, and Thieu Tri are separate tickets too. At dusk, walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh. How long the courts take, and the ride to a tomb, is check on arrival.

The night streets the city desk treats as phố Tây are Chu Văn An, Phạm Ngũ Lão, and Võ Thị Sáu. No closing hour is published. One 22:00 line was a single business, not a city rule. Go to Hoi An when the old town after dark is the reason you came. The road time from Hue is check on arrival.
gettingAround: Walk the south bank and cross Phu Xuan Bridge for the Imperial City. Truong Tien Bridge is the other crossing, at the start of the river path. The parks center has asked the ward police to stop electric bikes on that path. The tombs are upstream. A bicycle or a taxi is how travelers go, and the minutes are check on arrival. The 2026 tourism plan talks about free visitor buses and electric boats. Those are plans, not a timetable.

Ga Huế is on the north–south line, 103 km from Da Nang by the railway kilometre board. A street number for the station door is check on arrival. Phu Bai is southeast of the centre: 13 km on the civil-aviation chart, about 15 km on the national tourism page. No bus was serving the terminal in the airport’s replies of 29 September 2024 and 15 January 2025. The ride in minutes is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: South bank
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on the south bank, the modern side of the river. Which block faces the water is check on arrival. No hotel street is published.

eat: Eat bun bo Hue at Dong Ba, com hen on Hen Island, bánh khoái along Kim Long, and nem lụi from a street stall. The small steamed cakes are a snack. A stall price is check on arrival, and so is the hour. The food guide names the areas and leaves the shop names off the page.
A court-style set meal is a visitor set piece. It is optional. The bowl that tells you where you are is bun bo Hue.
interestsBody: Hue food is bun bo at Dong Ba, com hen on Hen Island, bánh khoái along Kim Long, and nem lụi from a street the national page does not name. It is not mi Quang and not cao lau. A stall price is check on arrival.
The Imperial City is the morning. The adult ticket is 200,000 VND, and it stops at those walls.

The royal tombs are upstream. Tu Duc’s garden, Minh Mang’s axis, and Khai Dinh’s compact tomb are on the four-site ticket with the Imperial City, 530,000 VND for an adult, usable for up to two days from the first visit. Gia Long, Dong Khanh, and Thieu Tri are not on that ticket.

Thien Mu is the seven-tiered tower in Kim Long. Tu Hieu, Dieu De, and Bao Quoc are the other pagoda stops. The fee and the hours at Thien Mu are check on arrival. Phu Cam is the cathedral on Phước Quả hill, not a pagoda. The city page prints both 01 Đoàn Hữu Trưng and 06 Nguyễn Trường Tộ. A fee is check on arrival.
The river evening is the walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh, with Kỳ Đài on the north bank. No fee and no hour are published for the path.
Thanh Toan is the tiled bridge in the plots, about 8 km southeast. The fee and the hours are check on arrival.
The night streets the desk calls phố Tây are Chu Văn An, Phạm Ngũ Lão, and Võ Thị Sáu. Closing hours are check on arrival. No bar is a pick.

season.label: February to April
season.note: Vietnam Tourism names February to April as the window, and September to November for heavy rain and typhoons. The city’s disaster plan, Decision 3279 of 6 October 2026, puts the hot season at May to September, 35°C to 40°C under the foehn, and the cool season at October to March, 20°C to 22°C on the plain. Rain averages above 2,700 mm and is concentrated from September to February, with November about 70 percent of the year. On the Perfume River the early flood is May to June and the main flood is September to December, especially October and November. The coast takes about 3 to 5 storms a year. Check the river path and Hai Van on a flood morning. No written shutdown hour was published.

faqs.q: What does one day in Hue look like?
faqs.a: Start at the Imperial City when the gate opens, on the 200,000 VND ticket. The tombs are a separate ride, and the minutes are check on arrival. At dusk, walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh. That is one outline. The four-site ticket’s two-day window is a ticket rule, not a second route.

faqs.q: Does the citadel ticket include the tombs?
faqs.a: No. The Imperial City is 200,000 VND for an adult and 40,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12. Under 7 is free. Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh are 150,000 VND each for an adult and 30,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12. The four-site ticket is 530,000 VND for an adult and 100,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12, and it lasts up to two days from the first visit. Gia Long is 150,000 VND for an adult, and a child from 7 to 12 is free. Dong Khanh is 100,000 VND for an adult, child free. Thieu Tri, An Dinh, and Nam Giao are 50,000 VND for an adult, child free. None of those is on the four-site ticket. The same adult price applies to an international visitor and a Vietnamese visitor. Hue residents and the other groups named in the resolution pay half.
